from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; y=df['dA_dt'].values
V=np.var(y)
forms={
 'F1 t^a/(1+bA) + t^c exp(-dA)': (lambda p: p[0]/t + p[1]*A/(1+p[2]*A)*t**3 + p[3]*t**p[4]/(1+p[5]*A) + p[6]*t**p[7]*np.exp(-p[8]*A), 9),
 'F2 t^a exp(-bA) + c*A^d/(1+e t)': (lambda p: p[0]/t + p[1]*A/(1+p[2]*A)*t**3 + p[3]*t**p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*A) + p[6]*A**p[7]/(1+p[8]*t), 9),
 'F3 t^a exp(-bt) A^c + d t^e/(1+fA)': (lambda p: p[0]/t + p[1]*A/(1+p[2]*A)*t**3 + p[3]*t**p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*t)*A**p[6] + p[7]*t**p[8]/(1+p[9]*A), 10),
 'F4 A^a exp(-b A)*t^c + d*log(1+e t)*A^f': (lambda p: p[0]/t + p[1]*A/(1+p[2]*A)*t**3 + p[3]*A**p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*A)*t**p[6] + p[7]*np.log(1+p[8]*t)*A**p[9], 10),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for name,(f,n) in forms.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(12):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,n)
        p0[2]=abs(p0[2])+0.2
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, p0, max_nfev=3000)
        except Exception as e:
            continue
        if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
    print(name, 'NMSE', 2*best.cost/len(y)/V, np.round(best.x,4))

 'G1': (lambda p: p[0]/t + p[1]*A/(1+p[2]*A)*t**3 + p[3]*t**p[4]*A**p[5]*np.exp(-p[6]*A) + p[7]*np.log(1+p[8]*t)/(1+p[9]*A), 10),
 'G2': (lambda p: p[0]/t + p[1]*A/(1+p[2]*A)*t**3 + p[3]*np.sqrt(t)*np.exp(-p[4]*A) + p[5]*np.log(1+p[6]*t)*A**p[7]/(1+p[8]*A), 9),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
for name,(f,n) in forms.items():

        p0=rng.normal(0,1,n); p0[2]=abs(p0[2])+0.1; p0[8]=abs(p0[8])+0.1
